law_text: A person, except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted, shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway nor enter upon a highway unless and until such movement can be made with safety.

requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: No accepted original C227890 evidence; all six constructed variants require source-bound physical verification.
requirement_dispositions.requirement: start from a parked position on a highway only when movement can be made with safety

runtime_uncertainties: Physical realization of public highway, lawful parking location, approach routes, departures and four-camera coverage requires later original Native capture and review.
Whether any particular movement can be made with safety is a legal and factual judgment; no invented distance or time cutoff is asserted.
Stopping, standing and entering-highway alternatives outside the frozen parked-departure witness are not asserted by these selected cases.

selected_branches.branch: Start from a parked position on a highway
required_context: Establish highway boundaries, public-authority dedication and public vehicular use.
Place an ordinary motor vehicle initially parked within those boundaries, with no actual loading, unloading or passenger exchange.
Supply the location-specific legal basis establishing that parking is permitted at the relevant time.
Specify the other vehicle's classification, route, position, motion and purpose relative to the departure.

topic_inventory.exact-text: A person, except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted, shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway nor enter upon a highway unless and until such movement can be made with safety.

witness_review.branch: Start from a parked position on a highway
